about: Sight line from base portal 11260 (a 3-unit triangle, cluster 2017) through 21 portals, 13,600 units. Default flow on the baseline build loses it at the last portal: the separator plane through a 0.012-unit edge of the previous window (0.08 units when the flow runs in double) and a base vertex 13,000 units away is accepted with the base's vertices 0.01 from it, at the clip epsilon (issue #89). Kept by the float and double prtvis ports and by vvis -mergeflow: whether float loses it depends on the build's rounding.
source: gm_fightspace_redux.vmf compiled by GMod's vbsp without func_viscluster: 3970 clusters, 10628 portals; portal i of this file is directed portal source_portals[i] of that .prt
